Set $u = t^3$, $dv = t\,e^{t^2}\,dt$, so $du = 3t^2\,dt$, $v = \frac{1}{2}e^{t^2}$:
$$\int t^4 e^{t^2}\,dt = \frac{t^3}{2}e^{t^2} - \frac{3}{2}\int t^2 e^{t^2}\,dt.$$

For $\int t^2 e^{t^2}\,dt$, set $u = t$, $dv = t\,e^{t^2}\,dt$:
$$\int t^2 e^{t^2}\,dt = \frac{t}{2}e^{t^2} - \frac{1}{2}\int e^{t^2}\,dt.$$
